question: Assume today is 2026-10-27. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate BYD Company Limited's operating revenue for the three months July-September 2026 (the third quarter alone, not January-September), in Chinese yuan (CNY), as it will be first reported in BYD's unaudited third quarterly report (key accounting data table, 'The Reporting Period' column).

target.what: Consolidated operating revenue (营业收入/营业总收入) of BYD Company Limited and its subsidiaries for the three months 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30, as first reported in the 'The Reporting Period' column of BYD's unaudited third quarterly report key accounting data table, in Chinese yuan. This is Q3 alone, not Ja
target.publisher: BYD Company Limited (HKEX: 1211; SZSE: 002594), unaudited third quarterly report
target.cadence: quarterly (Chinese A-share quarterly report and HKEX announcement)
target.caveats: Target is the first-reported unaudited Q3 2026 consolidated operating revenue, not a later restatement. It includes BYD Electronic and other consolidated subsidiaries and is after intersegment eliminations; it is not BYD Auto revenue alone. The report may not have been published by the 2026-10-27 cu

candidates.hypothesis: BYD's own quarterly revenue history provides the base for Q3 2026: Q3 revenue should track Q3 2025 revenue and adjacent 2026 quarters, updated by Q3 2026 unit-volume growth and segment mix. Symbolically, revenue_Q3_2026 is a seasonally and mix-adjusted growth on revenue_Q3_2025 or revenue_Q2_2026.
candidates.data_to_find: BYD unaudited quarterly consolidated operating revenue for Q3 2025, Q4 2025, Q1 2026 and Q2 2026; H1 2026 report and any segment revenue disclosed; quarterly vehicle sales for the same quarters. Minimum evidence: Q3 2025 and Q2 2026 revenue plus Q3 2026 sales volumes.

assessment.note: All report BYD Q1 2026 consolidated operating revenue near CNY 150.225bn. p46 gives the exact 150,225,314,000 figure; p1/p31/p16 are rounded versions of the same company filing, so they corroborate but are not independent measurements.
Q2 2026 consolidated revenue is consistently about CNY 194.59bn. p149 rounds to CNY 194.6bn. These come from the same quarterly report/derived commentary, so they are one underlying source.
H1 2026 operating revenue is CNY 344.815bn; p179 rounds to CNY 344.82bn. This is consistent with Q1 2026 plus Q2 2026.
Q3 2025 consolidated revenue is CNY 194.9846bn exactly in the quarterly table; p205/p219/p234 round or restate the same quarter to about CNY 195bn.
Q3 2025 automotive revenue excluding BYD Electronics is about CNY 152.31bn. p206/p235 round to CNY 152.3bn.
Q3 2025 total vehicle sales were 1.114m. p207 is 1.106m passenger vehicles, which is consistent with a small commercial-vehicle component.
January-September 2026 cumulative NEV sales are 3,131,576. These are repeated versions of the same monthly sales announcement.
H1 2026 NEV volume is 1,808,500 and H1 2026 exports are 790,000. These allow Q3 2026 volume and export share to be derived by subtracting H1 from January-September.
September 2026 total vehicle/NEV sales are about 463,561; p112 rounds to 46.36万辆. Same monthly sales announcement.
August 2026 BYD NEV shipments are about 432,684; CPCA wholesale 433,384 differs slightly by definition/rounding. Not a material conflict for Q3 volume.

The period labels are inconsistent: p310/p263's CNY 123.285bn 9M revenue and p265's CNY 42.68bn Q3 revenue align with 2025 actuals, not 2026 actuals. Q3 2025 revenue of CNY 42.68bn plus H1 2025 CNY 80.606bn gives CNY 123.286bn, matching p310. Treat p265 as a Q3 2025 analogue, not as Q3 2026 actual BYD Electronics revenue.

The article implies prior-year Q3 revenue of CNY 213.06bn, but BYD's actual Q3 2025 revenue was CNY 194.98bn. The base period or entity scope is inconsistent; unusable as a Q3 2026 revenue anchor.

Q2 2026 BYD ASP excluding BYD Electronics is CNY 136k. Same actual/analyst calculation repeated.

January-September 2026 exports of 1.338m minus H1 2026 exports of 0.790m imply Q3 2026 exports near 0.548m, or about 41.4% of derived Q3 volume. This is slightly below Q2 2026's ~43.3% export share and matters for the Q3 ASP assumption.
September 2026 premium-brand share was 13.5%, versus H1 2026 12.8%. This suggests a small positive Q3 mix effect, but only one month is observed and the effect on ASP is modest.
Full-year and stale consensus forecasts are inconsistent with H1 2026 run-rate and/or refer to later quarters. They are not suitable Q3 2026 revenue methods, only loose context.

methods.rationale: Builds Q3 2026 consolidated revenue as Q3 vehicle volume times latest observed ex-electronics ASP, plus Q3 BYD Electronic revenue. Q3 volume is derived as January-September cumulative minus H1 cumulative. H1 2026 auto ex-electronics plus BYD Electronic equals H1 consolidated revenue, supporting the two-component sum. assumptions.name: Q3 2026 ASP relative to Q2 2026 ex-electronics ASP
assumptions.rationale: Q2 2026 ASP excluding BYD Electronics was CNY 136k. Q3 2026 export share is slightly lower than Q2 (derived from p429/p328/p96/p327), while September premium-brand share was slightly higher (p89 vs p187). Price competition persists, so a near-flat ASP with a wide range is appropriate.
assumptions.applies_when: Used in m1 to transfer the latest observed Q2 2026 ex-electronics ASP to Q3 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that Q3 2026 auto ASP was materially above CNY 145k or below CNY 125k, or a large change in export/premium mix not captured here.

assumptions.name: Q3 2026 total revenue per vehicle relative to Q3 2025
assumptions.rationale: Q3 2025 total revenue per vehicle was about CNY 175k. With Q3 2026 auto ASP near Q2's CNY 136k and BYD Electronic revenue per vehicle lower than Q2, total revenue per vehicle should be modestly lower than Q3 2025 despite higher volume.
assumptions.applies_when: Used in m2 to scale Q3 2025 consolidated revenue by Q3 2026 vehicle volume.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that Q3 2026 ASP or electronics revenue per vehicle rose enough to keep total revenue per vehicle at or above Q3 2025 levels.

assumptions.name: Q3 2026 total revenue per vehicle relative to Q2 2026
assumptions.rationale: Q2 2026 total revenue per vehicle was about CNY 175.6k. Q3 2026 auto ASP is likely flat, while BYD Electronic revenue per vehicle falls because electronics revenue is roughly stable but vehicle volume rises; this points to a modest decline in total revenue per vehicle.
assumptions.applies_when: Used in m3 to scale Q2 2026 consolidated revenue by Q3 2026 vehicle volume.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that Q3 2026 total revenue per vehicle was materially above Q2 2026, for example a large ASP increase or a surge in electronics revenue.

assumptions.name: BYD Electronic Q3 2026 revenue as a fraction of H1 2026 revenue
assumptions.rationale: H1 2026 BYD Electronic revenue was CNY 82.234bn. Q3 2025 revenue of CNY 42.68bn against H1 2025 CNY 80.606bn implies a Q3/H1 ratio around 0.53. Q3 2026 likely has similar seasonality, so 0.52 with a range is reasonable.
assumptions.applies_when: Used in m1 to convert observed H1 2026 BYD Electronic revenue into a Q3 2026 estimate.
assumptions.falsified_by: Actual Q3 2026 BYD Electronic revenue materially below CNY 39bn or above CNY 46bn.

assessment.note: September 2026 total NEV sales cluster at 463,561; July 419k and August 440,293k sum with September to about 1.323m. Official 9M 3,131,576 less H1 1,808,500 gives 1,323,076, matching p572. Multiple URLs often repeat the same company monthly filing, so this is consistency rather than independent measurement.

September NEV exports 180,700/181,000 and passenger/pickup 179,877 are consistent within scope and rounding; Q3 export 550,700 and 41.6% share match Jul-Aug-Sep monthly export totals. Citi's 568k Q3 export assumption is a forecast, not actual, but close to realised volume.
Q3 2025 consolidated revenue 194.98bn, volume 1.114m, automotive revenue 152.3bn, ASP 137-138k. The exact quarterly table p354 is preferred as the historical baseline.
Q2 2026 revenue 194.59-194.6bn and volume 1.108-1.11m; ex-BYD-Electronic ASP 136k. p170 H1 ASP 143k domestic/163k export is a different period and method, not a contradiction.

H1 2026 total revenue 344.815bn; auto segment 275.341bn and electronics segment 69.405bn sum near total after eliminations. BYD Electronic company revenue 82.234bn is larger than the electronics segment because intercompany sales are eliminated, so p272 and p319 are different scopes.
BYD Electronic 9M 2026 revenue 123.285bn and H1 82.234bn imply Q3 of about 41.05bn. p265's 42.68bn conflicts with this arithmetic and has an implausible pre-Q3-end date, so it is discarded.
Goldman's single-source forecast 242.936bn conflicts with caifuhao's 222-229bn volume-by-per-vehicle estimate. The gap is about 6-9%; treat Goldman as an upper cross-check, not independent actual.

Q3 2026 export share about 41.6% vs Q2 about 42.4-43.3% and Q3 2025 20.8%; premium brand share 13.5% in September vs H1 12.8%. Mix supports stable-to-slightly-higher ASP but not a large jump; domestic market share is 25% in Q3 vs 22% in Q2.
Citi's Q3 assumptions (752k domestic plus 568k export) sum to 1.32m, consistent with actual Q3 volume 1.323m and export 550.7k; the export assumption is about 17k high but the total is close.

methods.rationale: Q3 volume is official 9M cumulative less H1 cumulative (p96 minus p327). Multiplying by Q2 ex-BYD-Electronic per-vehicle revenue (p141) and adjusting for Q3 mix gives the non-BYD-Electronic portion. Q3 BYD Electronic revenue is directly p522 minus p272, not an assumption. Adding the two reconstructs consolidated operating revenue because p141 is defined as total revenue less full BYD Electronic revenue. Main risks are Q3 ASP/mix and timing differences between BYD Electronic 9M data and group consolidation; intersegment eliminations are already embedded in the p141 relationship.

This captures the large export-share increase versus Q3 2025 but also allows domestic price competition and lower electronics revenue per vehicle. It uses the same volume inputs as m1 but a different revenue baseline and ASP treatment; a2 is the main uncertainty.

methods.rationale: Scales Q2 2026 consolidated revenue (p135) by Q3 2026 volume divided by Q2 2026 volume (p137), then applies a3 for per-vehicle revenue change. Q2 is the most recent reported quarter and already includes the high export mix. The method tests whether Q3 revenue grows roughly in line with the 19% sequential volume increase offset by lower BYD Electronic revenue per vehicle and modest ASP/mix changes. Main risk: Q2 ASP was unusually low, so a3 could be too low if Q3 mix improves more than expected.

assumptions.name: Q3 2026 ASP excluding BYD Electronic relative to Q2 2026 ex-electronics ASP
assumptions.rationale: Q2 2026 ex-BYD-Electronic ASP was 136k (p141), while Q3 2025 was 137k (p236). Q3 2026 export share is slightly lower than Q2 (41.6% p574 vs 42.4% p138) but premium share rose to 13.5% (p89 vs H1 12.8% p187), and domestic market share improved to 25% (p200/p365). New flash-charge models may help ASP, but domestic price competition remains; hence a small upward adjustment to Q2 with a wide range.
assumptions.applies_when: Used in m1, where Q3 volume is multiplied by Q2 ex-electronics ASP and then BYD Electronic Q3 revenue is added.
assumptions.falsified_by: Reported Q3 2026 automotive revenue per vehicle ex-BYD-Electronic outside roughly 128k-147k CNY/vehicle, or a sharp export/premium mix reversal versus Q2.

assumptions.name: Q3 2026 consolidated revenue per vehicle relative to Q3 2025
assumptions.rationale: Q3 2025 consolidated revenue per vehicle was about 175k (p354 / p221), and Q2 2026 was about 176k (p135 / p137). Q3 2026 volume rises to about 1.323m, but BYD Electronic revenue is roughly flat at about 41bn (p522 minus p272) versus about 44bn in Q2 (p272 minus p3), so electronics revenue per vehicle falls. Auto ASP should be similar to Q2 after mix adjustments. Thus total revenue per vehicle is likely a few percent below Q3 2025, with a wide range for price and mix.
assumptions.applies_when: Used in m2 to scale Q3 2025 consolidated revenue by the Q3 2026/Q3 2025 volume ratio.
assumptions.falsified_by: Q3 2026 revenue per vehicle materially above Q3 2025, for example if electronics revenue or export ASP surges.

assumptions.name: Q3 2026 consolidated revenue per vehicle relative to Q2 2026
assumptions.rationale: Q2 2026 consolidated revenue per vehicle was about 176k (p135 / p137). Q3 volume is about 19% higher sequentially, but BYD Electronic revenue is roughly flat, so its per-vehicle contribution falls from about 40k to about 31k. Export share edges down from 42.4% to 41.6% (p138 vs p574), while premium mix improves slightly (p89). Total revenue per vehicle should therefore be below Q2, around 4% lower, with a range allowing for stronger ASP or electronics.
assumptions.applies_when: Used in m3 to scale Q2 2026 consolidated revenue by the Q3 2026/Q2 2026 volume ratio.
assumptions.falsified_by: Q3 2026 consolidated revenue per vehicle at or above Q2 2026, or a large upward ASP/mix surprise.

final.template:
Best estimate for BYD Company Limited's consolidated operating revenue for the single quarter 2026-[n]-[n] to 2026-[n]-[n] (Q3 alone, not January-September), as first reported in the unaudited third quarterly report, is [[estimate]] [[unit]] ([[interval_level]] interval [[p10]] to [[p90]] [[unit]]).

Main evidence: Q3 volume is derived from official cumulative sales [[p96_value]] less H1 [[p327_value]]. Method m1 multiplies that volume by Q2 ex-BYD-Electronic per-vehicle revenue [[p141_value]] and adds Q3 BYD Electronic revenue ([[p522_value]] minus [[p272_value]]). Methods m2 and m3 scale prior-quarter revenue ([[p354_value]], [[p135_value]]) by volume ratios ([[p221_value]], [[p137_value]]).

Observed: volumes, prior revenues, electronics revenue. Assumption-dependent: per-vehicle adjustments [[a1_value]], [[a2_value]], [[a3_value]]. The three blocks were combined with equal weight per block because their inputs overlap heavily; the interval reflects the blocks' own model-based widths, not demonstrated accuracy.

Key risk: the per-vehicle revenue assumptions, especially electronics revenue per vehicle and export mix. Better evidence would be monthly Q3 revenue or segment disclosures.

Unit of the estimate: [[unit_full]].

Key assumptions (proposed by the analyst model, not observed; code samples each one between the bounds shown):
- a1 Q3 2026 ASP excluding BYD Electronic relative to Q2 2026 ex-electronics ASP: [[a1_value]] dimensionless, range [[a1_low]] to [[a1_high]] (range widened by code); used by m1. Overturned by: Reported Q3 2026 automotive revenue per vehicle ex-BYD-Electronic outside roughly [n]k-[n]k CNY/vehicle, or a sharp export/premium mix reversal versus Q2.
- a2 Q3 2026 consolidated revenue per vehicle relative to Q3 2025: [[a2_value]] dimensionless, range [[a2_low]] to [[a2_high]] (range widened by code); used by m2. Overturned by: Q3 2026 revenue per vehicle materially above Q3 2025, for example if electronics revenue or export ASP surges.
- a3 Q3 2026 consolidated revenue per vehicle relative to Q2 2026: [[a3_value]] dimensionless, range [[a3_low]] to [[a3_high]] (range widened by code); used by m3. Overturned by: Q3 2026 consolidated revenue per vehicle at or above Q2 2026, or a large upward ASP/mix surprise.

Method details (computed by code):
- m1 formula_mc: (vol_cum - vol_h1) * asp_q2 * a1 + (be_9m - be_h1); Monte Carlo P10 to P90 [[m1_mc_p10]] to [[m1_mc_p90]]; result unit CNY converted to CNY; own 80% width [[m1_width]] (Monte Carlo of the formula inputs)
- m2 formula_mc: rev_q3_25 * ((vol_cum - vol_h1) / vol_q3_25) * a2; Monte Carlo P10 to P90 [[m2_mc_p10]] to [[m2_mc_p90]]; result unit (0.3333333333 CNY/month) * 92 day converted to CNY; own 80% width [[m2_width]] (Monte Carlo of the formula inputs)
- m3 formula_mc: rev_q2 * ((vol_cum - vol_h1) / vol_q2) * a3; Monte Carlo P10 to P90 [[m3_mc_p10]] to [[m3_mc_p90]]; result unit (0.3333333333 CNY/month) * 92 day converted to CNY; own 80% width [[m3_width]] (Monte Carlo of the formula inputs)
- Combination: [[n_blocks]] block(s), equal weight per block (methods whose inputs overlap by at least half form one block; backtest errors set widths, not weights): B1 = m1: [[block1_value]] (width [[block1_width]], Monte Carlo of the formula inputs); B2 = m2: [[block2_value]] (width [[block2_width]], Monte Carlo of the formula inputs); B3 = m3: [[block3_value]] (width [[block3_width]], Monte Carlo of the formula inputs). Estimate = the median of the blocks.
- Interval: root mean square of the block widths [[blocks_rms_width]]; Birge ratio [[birge_ratio]] (not above one, so no widening); final width [[final_width]].
final.text:
Best estimate for BYD Company Limited's consolidated operating revenue for the single quarter 2026-[n]-[n] to 2026-[n]-[n] (Q3 alone, not January-September), as first reported in the unaudited third quarterly report, is 219,760,222,076 CNY (80% model-based interval 114,466,292,271 to 421,910,714,927 CNY).

Main evidence: Q3 volume is derived from official cumulative sales 3,131,576 vehicle less H1 1,808,500 vehicle. Method m1 multiplies that volume by Q2 ex-BYD-Electronic per-vehicle revenue 136,000 CNY/vehicle and adds Q3 BYD Electronic revenue (123,285,000,000 CNY minus 82,234,000,000 CNY). Methods m2 and m3 scale prior-quarter revenue (194,984,598,000 CNY, 194,590,000,000 CNY) by volume ratios (1,114,000 vehicle, 1,108,000 vehicle).

Observed: volumes, prior revenues, electronics revenue. Assumption-dependent: per-vehicle adjustments 1.01, 0.96, 0.96. The three blocks were combined with equal weight per block because their inputs overlap heavily; the interval reflects the blocks' own model-based widths, not demonstrated accuracy.

Key risk: the per-vehicle revenue assumptions, especially electronics revenue per vehicle and export mix. Better evidence would be monthly Q3 revenue or segment disclosures.

Unit of the estimate: CNY (Chinese yuan (CNY); total for 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30).

Key assumptions (proposed by the analyst model, not observed; code samples each one between the bounds shown):
- a1 Q3 2026 ASP excluding BYD Electronic relative to Q2 2026 ex-electronics ASP: 1.01 dimensionless, range 0.7125 to 1.425 (range widened by code); used by m1. Overturned by: Reported Q3 2026 automotive revenue per vehicle ex-BYD-Electronic outside roughly [n]k-[n]k CNY/vehicle, or a sharp export/premium mix reversal versus Q2.
- a2 Q3 2026 consolidated revenue per vehicle relative to Q3 2025: 0.96 dimensionless, range 0.6808 to 1.362 (range widened by code); used by m2. Overturned by: Q3 2026 revenue per vehicle materially above Q3 2025, for example if electronics revenue or export ASP surges.
- a3 Q3 2026 consolidated revenue per vehicle relative to Q2 2026: 0.96 dimensionless, range 0.6775 to 1.355 (range widened by code); used by m3. Overturned by: Q3 2026 consolidated revenue per vehicle at or above Q2 2026, or a large upward ASP/mix surprise.

Method details (computed by code):
- m1 formula_mc: (vol_cum - vol_h1) * asp_q2 * a1 + (be_9m - be_h1); Monte Carlo P10 to P90 121,277,448,888 to 366,669,375,657; result unit CNY converted to CNY; own 80% width x/÷1.74 (Monte Carlo of the formula inputs)
- m2 formula_mc: rev_q3_25 * ((vol_cum - vol_h1) / vol_q3_25) * a2; Monte Carlo P10 to P90 100,799,054,723 to 407,288,943,655; result unit (0.3333333333 CNY/month) * 92 day converted to CNY; own 80% width x/÷2.01 (Monte Carlo of the formula inputs)
- m3 formula_mc: rev_q2 * ((vol_cum - vol_h1) / vol_q2) * a3; Monte Carlo P10 to P90 101,605,432,520 to 407,809,255,887; result unit (0.3333333333 CNY/month) * 92 day converted to CNY; own 80% width x/÷2.00 (Monte Carlo of the formula inputs)
- Combination: 3 block(s), equal weight per block (methods whose inputs overlap by at least half form one block; backtest errors set widths, not weights): B1 = m1: 219,760,222,076 (width x/÷1.74, Monte Carlo of the formula inputs); B2 = m2: 220,287,835,890 (width x/÷2.01, Monte Carlo of the formula inputs); B3 = m3: 217,816,169,010 (width x/÷2.00, Monte Carlo of the formula inputs). Estimate = the median of the blocks.
- Interval: root mean square of the block widths x/÷1.92; Birge ratio 0.01 (not above one, so no widening); final width x/÷1.92.

placeholders.interval_basis: several routes with separate inputs: the width is the typical width of the routes' own intervals, not narrowed for their number

final.model_text:
Best estimate for BYD Company Limited's consolidated operating revenue for the single quarter 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30 (Q3 alone, not January-September), as first reported in the unaudited third quarterly report, is [[estimate]] [[unit]] ([[interval_level]] interval [[p10]] to [[p90]] [[unit]]).

Main evidence: Q3 volume is derived from official cumulative sales [[p96_value]] less H1 [[p327_value]]. Method m1 multiplies that volume by Q2 ex-BYD-Electronic per-vehicle revenue [[p141_value]] and adds Q3 BYD Electronic revenue ([[p522_value]] minus [[p272_value]]). Methods m2 and m3 scale prior-quarter revenue ([[p354_value]], [[p135_value]]) by volume ratios ([[p221_value]], [[p137_value]]).

Observed: volumes, prior revenues, electronics revenue. Assumption-dependent: per-vehicle adjustments [[a1_value]], [[a2_value]], [[a3_value]]. The three blocks were combined with equal weight per block because their inputs overlap heavily; the interval reflects the blocks' own model-based widths, not demonstrated accuracy.

Key risk: the per-vehicle revenue assumptions, especially electronics revenue per vehicle and export mix. Better evidence would be monthly Q3 revenue or segment disclosures.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
